title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday: Chamber Gives Back at Convoy of Hope
description: Giving Tuesday - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope takes place on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM. It is held at Convoy of Hope's World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, in Springfield, MO. The event is hosted by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce.
venue: Convoy of Hope's World Distribution Center
